skills.description:
This skill compiles a vocabulary spreadsheet (xlsx / csv word list with columns such as
单词 / 音标 / 词性 / 中文意思 / 单元 / 页号 / 课次) into ONE self-contained static HTML
spelling-practice page: all CSS and JavaScript inlined (three.js is bundled inside too),
no CDN, no fonts to download — double-click to run, works offline and from file://. The
generated page keeps the original 背单词 interaction model: a plan panel (unit / lesson /
mode / batch size), a single-card focus view with four progressive masking rounds
(认形 → 元音 → 骨架 → 默写), per-letter error feedback with three attempts, a reveal panel
with phonetics, senses and natural-phonics hints, spaced-repetition scheduling (1/2/4/7/15/30
days) persisted in localStorage, plus custom word lists. It also keeps the original 3D stage:
nine procedural three.js scenes (classroom / outdoor / beach / Big Ben / Great Wall /
Liberty / mountain / space / 邯郸道夜景) shuffled per session and rotated one per round,
plus a 3D cat-teacher mascot ("猫老师": 墨绿西装 + 砖红领结 + 金丝圆框眼镜 + 屏幕脸 + 教鞭 + 头顶天线)
standing in the bottom-right corner holding the current word board. Pass `--image` to
inject the user's own photo: the build turns it into the 9th scene by replacing 邯郸道夜景
in the rotation, guaranteed to appear once per session (the preset count stays 9).
The output is about 790 KB (≈860 KB with a photo) because three.js is bundled inside; it
still needs no network.
Use it when a user wants to turn a textbook word table
(冀教版 / 人教版 / 外研版 英语单词表) into a ready-to-use 背单词 / 默写 / 拼写练习 网页, or asks
for a "single HTML file" vocabulary trainer for teachers, parents or students. Pick this
variant when the user explicitly wants a 3D / animated stage, or asks for the version that
looks like a game; for the smaller 2D-only build (about 200 KB, no WebGL) use
`vocab-html-play` instead.
